data.name: Rayanah
data.gender_notes: Rayanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful name derived from the Arabic word 'Raiyan' which means 'gardener'. In Islamic tradition, Rayanah is considered the name of the angels who are in charge of watering the gardens of Paradise. Thus, the name is a beautiful reminder of the eternal paradise that awaits believers. The name Rayanah carries the meaning “Gardener of the (gardens) of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rayanah usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener of the (gardens) of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Rayanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener of the (gardens) of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayanah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

This name serves as a constant reminder of the eternal paradise that awaits one with diligent effort in living a righteous life.
